title: Dhumraksha enters the battle field
introduction: Hearing the rejoicing cries of the monkeys, Ravana asks some demons to discover the cause of that rejoicing. The demons mount the rampart and discover that Rama and Lakshmana have been relieved of the shackle of arrows. They come to Ravana and inform that the two brothers Rama and Lakshmana are alive and appear like two strong elephants in the battle-field. Ravana then calls Dhumraksha, a demon and asks him to go with an army and kill Rama, Lakshmana and the monkeys Dhumraksha along with his army enters the western gate of Lanks where the army-chief Hanuman is stationed. While Dhumraksha advances in the battle-field, he observes several bad omens and feels disturbed.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे एकपञ्चशः सर्गः
Thus completes 51st Chapter of Yuddha Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
तेषाम् सुतुमुलम् शब्दम् वानराणाम् तरस्विनाम् |
नर्दताम् राक्षसैह् सार्धम् तदा शुश्राव रावणः
verses.iast:
teṣām sutumulam śabdam vānarāṇām tarasvinām |
nardatām rākṣasaih sārdham tadā śuśrāva rāvaṇaḥ
verses.translation: That tumultuous sound, set up by the monkeys who were full of martial ardour, arrested the attention of Ravana and his demons.

glosses.meaning: who were full of martial ardour
and who were making a roaring sound.

verses.devanagari:
स्निग्ध गम्भीर निर्घोषम् श्रुत्वा स निनदम् भृशम् |
सचिवानाम् ततस् तेषाम् मध्ये वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
snigdha gambhīra nirghoṣam śrutvā sa ninadam bhṛśam |
sacivānām tatas teṣām madhye vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: Hearing that mighty clamour, sounding smooth and deep, Ravana spoke to his ministers who surrounded him.

glosses.meaning: in a smooth and deep sound

verses.devanagari:
यथा असौ सम्प्रहृष्टानाम् वानराणाम् समुत्थितः |
बहूनाम् सुमहान् नादो मेघानाम् इव गर्जताम्
व्यक्तम् सुमहती प्रीतिर् एतेषाम् न अत्र संशयः |
तथा हि विपुलैर् नादैश् चुक्षुभे वरुण आलयः
verses.iast:
yathā asau samprahṛṣṭānām vānarāṇām samutthitaḥ |
bahūnām sumahān nādo meghānām iva garjatām
vyaktam sumahatī prītir eteṣām na atra saṃśayaḥ |
tathā hi vipulair nādaiś cukṣubhe varuṇa ālayaḥ
verses.translation: "A great uproar, resembling the rumbling of clouds, has arisen from that horde of rejoiced monkeys. Undoubtedly their joy is great, their mighty roars are agitating the briny ocean itself.

glosses.meaning: as the rumbling sound of clouds

verses.devanagari:
तौ तु बद्धौ शरैस् तीष्क्णैर् भ्रातरौ राम लक्ष्मणौ |
अयम् च सुमहान् नादह् शन्काम् जनयति इव मे
verses.iast:
tau tu baddhau śarais tīṣkṇair bhrātarau rāma lakṣmaṇau |
ayam ca sumahān nādah śankām janayati iva me
verses.translation: "Those two brothers Rama and Lakshmana were tied by sharp arrows. This sound of a great magnitude being heard by me, is begetting an apprehension in me."

verses.devanagari:
एवम् च वचनम् च उक्त्वा मन्त्रिणो राक्षस ईश्वरः |
उवाच नैरृतांस् तत्र समीप परिवर्तिनः
verses.iast:
evam ca vacanam ca uktvā mantriṇo rākṣasa īśvaraḥ |
uvāca nairṛtāṃs tatra samīpa parivartinaḥ
verses.translation: Having spoken thus to his ministers, Ravana the Lord of Demons said to his demons who stood round him there (as follows)

verses.devanagari:
ज्नायताम् तूर्णम् एतषाम् सर्वेषाम् वन चारिणाम् |
शोक काले समुत्पन्ने हर्ष कारणम् उत्थितम्
verses.iast:
jnāyatām tūrṇam etaṣām sarveṣām vana cāriṇām |
śoka kāle samutpanne harṣa kāraṇam utthitam
verses.translation: "You immediately discover from what cause this general rejoicing among all these monkeys coming for the their present grievous situation!'

verses.devanagari:
तथा उक्तास् तेन सम्भ्रान्ताह् प्राकारम् अधिरुह्य ते |
ददृशुह् पालिताम् सेनाम् सुग्रीवेण महात्मना
तौ च मुक्तौ सुघोरेण शर बन्धेन राघवौ |
समुत्थितौ महा भागौ विषेदुह् प्रेक्ष्य राक्षसाः
verses.iast:
tathā uktās tena sambhrāntāh prākāram adhiruhya te |
dadṛśuh pālitām senām sugrīveṇa mahātmanā
tau ca muktau sughoreṇa śara bandhena rāghavau |
samutthitau mahā bhāgau viṣeduh prekṣya rākṣasāḥ
verses.translation: Thus commanded by Ravana, they mounted the rampart very briskly and saw the army lead by the high-souled Sugreeva and also the highly fortunate Rama and Lakshmana who were relieved of the terrific shackle of arrow a and risen up together. All the demons felt desponded on seeing it.

verses.devanagari:
सम्त्रस्त हृदया सर्वे प्राकाराद् अवरुह्य ते |
विवर्ण रक्षनाः घोरा राक्षस इन्द्रम् उपस्थिताः
verses.iast:
samtrasta hṛdayā sarve prākārād avaruhya te |
vivarṇa rakśanāḥ ghorā rākṣasa indram upasthitāḥ
verses.translation: With their hearts trembling with fear and faces turning pale, all those terrific demons descended from the rampart and approached Ravana.

glosses.meaning: with their hearts trembling with fear

verses.devanagari:
तद् अप्रियम् दीन मुखा रावणस्य निशा चराः |
कृत्स्नम् निवेदयाम् आसुर् यथावद् वाक्य कोविदाः
verses.iast:
tad apriyam dīna mukhā rāvaṇasya niśā carāḥ |
kṛtsnam nivedayām āsur yathāvad vākya kovidāḥ
verses.translation: With downcast faces, those demons skilled in speech, faithfully informed Ravana of those unpleasant tidings, saying:

verses.devanagari:
यौ ताव् इन्द्रजिता युद्धे भ्रातरौ राम लक्ष्मणौ |
निबद्धौ शर बन्धेन निष्प्रकम्प भुजौ कृतौ
विमुक्तौ शर बन्धेन तौ दृश्येते रण अजिरे |
पाशान् इव गजाउ चित्त्वा गज इन्द्र सम विक्रमौ
verses.iast:
yau tāv indrajitā yuddhe bhrātarau rāma lakṣmaṇau |
nibaddhau śara bandhena niṣprakampa bhujau kṛtau
vimuktau śara bandhena tau dṛśyete raṇa ajire |
pāśān iva gajāu cittvā gaja indra sama vikramau
verses.translation: "The two brothers, Rama and Lakshmana, whom Indrajit had bound with his benumbing shafts and whose arms he had pinioned, are free from the arrows which paralyzed them and now appear on the field of battle, as two strong elephants who have snapped their fetters."

glosses.meaning: with strength equal arms to best of elephants

verses.devanagari:
तत् श्रुत्वा वचनम् तेषाम् राक्षस इन्द्रो महा बलः |
चिन्ता शोक समाक्रान्तो विषण्ण वदनो अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tat śrutvā vacanam teṣām rākṣasa indro mahā balaḥ |
cintā śoka samākrānto viṣaṇṇa vadano abravīt
verses.translation: Hearing their words, the might Ravana was filled with anxiety and fury. His face became pale (and he spoke as follows):

glosses.meaning: was filled with anxiety and fury

verses.devanagari:
घोरैर् दत्त वरैर् बद्धौ शरैर् आशी विष उमपैः |
अमोघैह् सूर्य सम्काशैह् प्रमथ्य इन्द्रजिता युधि
तम् अस्त्र बन्धम् आसाद्य यदि मुक्तौ रिपू मम |
संशयस्थम् इदम् सर्वम् अनुपश्याम्य् अहम् बलम्
verses.iast:
ghorair datta varair baddhau śarair āśī viṣa umapaiḥ |
amoghaih sūrya samkāśaih pramathya indrajitā yudhi
tam astra bandham āsādya yadi muktau ripū mama |
saṃśayastham idam sarvam anupaśyāmy aham balam
verses.translation: "If my adversaries, having thus been bound by Indrajit are freed, despite their injuries in battle by his formidable arrows which were infallible those rare boons, resembling serpents, bright as the sun, I perceive my entire army in jeopardy."

verses.devanagari:
निष्फलाह् खलु सम्वृत्ताह् शरा वासुकि तेजसः |
आदत्तम् यैस् तु सम्ग्रामे रिपूणाम् मम जीवितम्
verses.iast:
niṣphalāh khalu samvṛttāh śarā vāsuki tejasaḥ |
ādattam yais tu samgrāme ripūṇām mama jīvitam
verses.translation: "Those very arrows, bright as fire, which in battle have taken the life of my enemies, have now been rendered void indeed!"

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्त्वा तु सम्क्रुद्धो निश्वसन्न् उरगो यथा |
अब्रवीद् रक्षसाम् मध्ये धूम्र अक्षम् नाम राकसम्
verses.iast:
evam uktvā tu samkruddho niśvasann urago yathā |
abravīd rakṣasām madhye dhūmra akṣam nāma rākasam
verses.translation: Having spoken thus in furious tones, hissing like a snake, he addressed a demon called Dhumraksha who was seated amidst the demons and said.

verses.devanagari:
बलेन महता युक्तो रक्षसाम् भीम कर्मणाम् |
त्वम् वधाय अभिनिर्याहि रामस्य सह वानरैः
verses.iast:
balena mahatā yukto rakṣasām bhīma karmaṇām |
tvam vadhāya abhiniryāhi rāmasya saha vānaraiḥ
verses.translation: "You, with a terrific prowess, go quickly with a considerable force of demons and slay Rama, Lakshmana and his monkeys."

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्तस् तु धूम्र अक्षो राक्षस इन्द्रेण धीमता |
कृत्वा प्रणामम् सम्हृष्टो निर्जगाम नृप आलयात्
verses.iast:
evam uktas tu dhūmra akṣo rākṣasa indreṇa dhīmatā |
kṛtvā praṇāmam samhṛṣṭo nirjagāma nṛpa ālayāt
verses.translation: Thus commanded by Ravana, the intelligent Dhumraksha, going past from there, quickly departed front her royal palace.

verses.devanagari:
अभिनिष्क्रम्य तद् द्वारम् बल अध्यक्षम् उवाच ह |
त्वरयस्व बलम् तूर्णम् किम् चिरेण युयुत्सतः
verses.iast:
abhiniṣkramya tad dvāram bala adhyakṣam uvāca ha |
tvarayasva balam tūrṇam kim cireṇa yuyutsataḥ
verses.translation: Having crossed that gate, he spoke to the General of the Forces as follows: "Mobilize the army. Hasten quickly. What need is there for the delay?"

glosses.meaning: to the General of the foreces (as follows)

verses.devanagari:
धूम्र अक्षस्य वचह् श्रुत्वा बल अध्यक्षो बल अनुगः |
बलम् उद्योजयाम् आस रावणस्य आज्नया द्रुतम्
verses.iast:
dhūmra akṣasya vacah śrutvā bala adhyakṣo bala anugaḥ |
balam udyojayām āsa rāvaṇasya ājnayā drutam
verses.translation: Hearing the words of Dhumraksha, the general of forces, having the army which followed him, kept the army ready quickly, as per Ravana's command.

glosses.meaning: having the army which followed him

verses.devanagari:
ते बद्ध घण्टा बलिनो घोर रूपा निशा चराः |
विनर्दमानाह् सम्हृष्टा धूम्र अक्षम् पर्यवारयन्
verses.iast:
te baddha ghaṇṭā balino ghora rūpā niśā carāḥ |
vinardamānāh samhṛṣṭā dhūmra akṣam paryavārayan
verses.translation: Those strong demons of terrific form, making sounds with bells hung on their bodies, joyously surrounded Dhumraksha.

verses.devanagari:
विविध आयुध हस्ताश् च शूल मुद्गर पाणयः |
गदाभिह् पट्टसैर् दण्डैर् आयसैर् मुसलैर् भृशम्
परिघैर् भिण्डि पालैश् च भल्लैह् प्रासैह् परश्वधैः |
निर्ययू राक्षसा घोरा नर्दन्तो जलदा यथा
verses.iast:
vividha āyudha hastāś ca śūla mudgara pāṇayaḥ |
gadābhih paṭṭasair daṇḍair āyasair musalair bhṛśam
parighair bhiṇḍi pālaiś ca bhallaih prāsaih paraśvadhaiḥ |
niryayū rākṣasā ghorā nardanto jaladā yathā
verses.translation: Furnished with every kind of weapon, brandishing spears, hammers, maces, harpoons, sticks, iron cudgels, bars, clubs, javelins, missiles, nooses and axes, those terrible demons sallied forth with the noise of thunder.

glosses.meaning: furnished with every kind of weapon

verses.devanagari:
रथैह् कवचिनस् त्व् अन्ये ध्वजैश् च समलम्कृतैः |
सुवर्ण जाल विहितैह् खरैश् च विविध आननैः
हयैः परम शीघ्रैश् च गज इन्द्रैश् च मद उत्कटैः |
निर्ययू राक्षस व्याघ्रा व्याघ्रा;इव दुरासदाः
verses.iast:
rathaih kavacinas tv anye dhvajaiś ca samalamkṛtaiḥ |
suvarṇa jāla vihitaih kharaiś ca vividha ānanaiḥ
hayaiḥ parama śīghraiś ca gaja indraiś ca mada utkaṭaiḥ |
niryayū rākṣasa vyāghrā vyāghrā;iva durāsadāḥ
verses.translation: Clad in mail, mounted on chariots that were magnificently dressed with flags and decorated with bands of pure gold, harnessed to mules of many heads or steeds of exceeding fleetness or elephants in furious rut, some other excellent demons went forth like veritable tigers.

glosses.meaning: and decorated with bands of pure gold

verses.devanagari:
मृग सिम्ह मुखैर् युक्तम् खरैह् कनक भूषणैः |
आरुरोह रथम् दिव्यम् धूम्र अक्षह् खर निस्वनः
verses.iast:
mṛga simha mukhair yuktam kharaih kanaka bhūṣaṇaiḥ |
āruroha ratham divyam dhūmra akṣah khara nisvanaḥ
verses.translation: Dhumraksha, with a mule-like clatter, set out in a celestial chariot to which mules adorned with gold and heads of deer and lions were hitched.

glosses.meaning: and heads of deed and lions

verses.devanagari:
स निर्यातो महा वीर्यो धूम्र अक्षो राक्षसैर् वृतः |
प्रहसन् पश्चिम द्वारम् हनूमान् यत्र यूथपः
verses.iast:
sa niryāto mahā vīryo dhūmra akṣo rākṣasair vṛtaḥ |
prahasan paścima dvāram hanūmān yatra yūthapaḥ
verses.translation: That Dhumraksha of mighty prowess, surrounded by demons, set forth amidst mocking laughter, through the western gate where the army-chief Hanuman was stationed.

verses.devanagari:
रथप्रवरमास्थाय खरयुक्तं खरस्वनम् |
प्रयान्तम् तु महा घोरम् राक्षसम् भीम दर्शनम्
अन्तरिक्ष गताह् क्रूराह् शकुनाह् प्रत्यवारयन् |
verses.iast:
rathapravaramāsthāya kharayuktaṃ kharasvanam |
prayāntam tu mahā ghoram rākṣasam bhīma darśanam
antarikṣa gatāh krūrāh śakunāh pratyavārayan |
verses.translation: As he mounted and advanced in an excellent chariot harnessed to mules, whose voices he emulated, birds of ill-omen in the sky obstructed that advancing demon of very terrible and fearful appearance.

verses.devanagari:
रथ शीर्षे महा भीमो गृध्रश् च निपपात ह
ध्वज अग्रे ग्रथिताश् चैव निपेतुह् कुणप अशनाः |
verses.iast:
ratha śīrṣe mahā bhīmo gṛdhraś ca nipapāta ha
dhvaja agre grathitāś caiva nipetuh kuṇapa aśanāḥ |
verses.translation: A highly terrible vulture alighted on the top of his chariot, while those devourers of corpses clustered on the point of his standard.

glosses.meaning: on the top of his chariot
on the point of his standard.

verses.devanagari:
रुधिर आर्द्रो महान् श्वेतह् कबन्धह् पतितो भुवि
विस्वरम् च उत्सृजन् नादम् धूम्र अक्षस्य समीपतः |
ववर्ष रुधिरम् देवह् संचचाल च मेदिनी
verses.iast:
rudhira ārdro mahān śvetah kabandhah patito bhuvi
visvaram ca utsṛjan nādam dhūmra akṣasya samīpataḥ |
vavarṣa rudhiram devah saṃcacāla ca medinī
verses.translation: Streming with blood, a huge decapitated trunk fell to earth, emitting inarticulate noise in Dhumraksha's vicinity and the sky rained down blood. The earth trembled.

glosses.meaning: in Dhumraksha's vicinity and the sky rained down blood. The earth trembled.

verses.devanagari:
प्रतिलोमम् ववौ वायुर् निर्घात सम निस्वनः |
तिमिर ओघ आवृतास् तत्र दिशश् च न चकाशिरे
verses.iast:
pratilomam vavau vāyur nirghāta sama nisvanaḥ |
timira ogha āvṛtās tatra diśaś ca na cakāśire
verses.translation: The wind with noise resembling a thunder blew adversely. Every quarter, obscured by abundant darkness, did not dazzle.

glosses.meaning: did not dazzle timirough vR^itaaH = as observed by abundant darkness.

verses.devanagari:
स तु उत्पातांस् ततो दृष्ट्वा राक्षसानाम् भय आवहान् |
प्रादुर् भूतान् सुघोरांश् च धूम्र अक्षो व्यथितो अभवत्
मुमुहू राक्षसाः सर्वे धूम्राक्षस्य पुरःसराः |
verses.iast:
sa tu utpātāṃs tato dṛṣṭvā rākṣasānām bhaya āvahān |
prādur bhūtān sughorāṃś ca dhūmra akṣo vyathito abhavat
mumuhū rākṣasāḥ sarve dhūmrākṣasya puraḥsarāḥ |
verses.translation: Seeing those terrible amones that appeared in all their horror to the demons, Dhumraksha became perturbed. Terror seized all the demons who were advancing in front of Dhumraksha.

verses.devanagari:
ततः सुभीमो बहुभिर् निशा चरैर् |
र्वृतो अभिनिष्क्रम्य रण उत्सुको बली |
ददर्श ताम् राघव बाहु पालिताम् |
समुद्र कल्पाम् बहु वानरीम् चमूम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ subhīmo bahubhir niśā carair |
rvṛto abhiniṣkramya raṇa utsuko balī |
dadarśa tām rāghava bāhu pālitām |
samudra kalpām bahu vānarīm camūm
verses.translation: Then, Dhumraksha, the highly terrible and strong demon, surrounded by a multitude of demons, eager to enter into combat, set out and beheld that army of a multitude of monkeys, resembling a flood, protected by the arms of Rama.

glosses.meaning: protected by the arms of Rama.
